motivation: Generic Skolem validity is coNP-complete and uniform rule synthesis is solver-equivalent on closed SAT instances, so debt discharge must use a frozen structured derivation calculus rather than an assumed generic oracle.
representation: GF(2) RREF plus hash-consed bounded-fanin Boolean DAG with definitional auxiliaries

candidate_calculus.name: SKOLEM_LOCAL_DERIVATION_V1
allowed_rule_forms: GUARDED_ITE(guard, rule_true, rule_false) with hash-consed sharing
allowed_justifications: LOCAL_GUARD_PARTITION whose two guards are exact complements and whose child derivations are independently valid
forbidden: unbounded SAT calls hidden inside rule synthesis
fresh alias counted as debt discharge
unproved semantic equivalence of a synthesized DAG
exponential branch tree hidden behind ITE without DAG sharing accounting

proof_contract.local_checker: Every derivation node must be checked from frozen RREF rows, frozen DAG definitions, or already checked child derivations in time polynomial in local proof size.
proof_contract.global_size_bound: Total Skolem derivation DAG bytes across the full run must be bounded by one fixed polynomial in original input length L.
proof_contract.synthesis_bound: Construction of all derivations must be polynomial in L and may not call an unverified solver oracle.
proof_contract.terminalization: TRUE/FALSE with zero live original bits and zero debt; SAT reconstructs an original assignment; UNSAT has independent replay.
proof_contract.uniformity: One finite calculus and one synthesis algorithm for all input lengths.

positive_controls: small guarded mux with both branches locally justified
first_attack_question: Can the frozen local calculus extract and certify implicit witness functions without generic coNP-complete validity checking and without an exponential guarded-ITE proof DAG?
failure_condition: A frozen hostile relation has a polynomial-size witness function but the calculus cannot derive it without forbidden generic validation, unbounded branching, or superpolynomial proof/synthesis size.
candidate_condition: The calculus derives and checks all debt rules and reaches exact terminal TRUE/FALSE with polynomial total cost on every PAIR+OR_3 input.
